name: Review
description: The Workbench's review: the task the inbox picked, its changed files and diffs, its commits and test runs on compute, and Land, Ask for changes or Discard (K2 asks you first).

reasons.agents:read: to open the task's terminal in K2 when you press Terminal
reasons.git:read: to show the task's branch, changed files, diffs and commits
reasons.git:notes: to send your line notes to the task's agent when you press Ask for changes
reasons.compute:read: to show the test runs the agent ran on compute for this branch
reasons.agents:start: to land, retire or discard the task when you press those buttons (K2 asks you first)
reasons.store:read: to follow the task the inbox picked and keep your unsent notes
